message.heading: To My Dearest Friends,
message.body:
Four years ago, we walked into this place as strangers — nervous, excited, and completely clueless about what lay ahead. We pulled all-nighters, survived impossible exams, laughed in the back rows of lectures we barely understood, and somewhere between the chaos and the calm, we became family.

Every photograph in this collection holds a piece of something irreplaceable. The late-night canteen runs, the panic before submissions, the celebrations after results — those moments are ours, and no amount of time can take them away.

This little website is my small way of saying: I'm so grateful it was you people beside me. Wherever life takes us next, I hope we carry these memories like a light.

With all my love,
Your Classmate ❤️
message.author: Made with love by your classmate

years.label: First Year
years.description: The year everything started. New faces, new fears, and a whole new world of possibilities. We were just figuring out who we were.

memories.caption: Day one on campus — that mix of excitement and terror we all shared.
First lecture ever. We sat in the front row trying to look smart.
The lab where we broke more code than we fixed. Good times.
First year cultural fest — we danced like nobody was watching (everybody was watching).
The reel we made for freshers' day. Pure chaos. Pure gold.
First semester exams. We studied. We survived. We questioned everything.

years.label: Second Year
years.description: We stopped being strangers and started being us. The friendships deepened, the jokes got worse, and somehow everything got better.

memories.caption: Group study sessions that were 20% study, 80% everything else.
The hackathon where we pulled our first all-nighter together.
Tech fest 2022 — our first big stage moment. We were terrified but electric.
The canteen table that basically became our second classroom.
Late night debugging sessions. We broke the internet. Twice.
Our second year farewell video. Already getting nostalgic in year two.

years.label: Third Year
years.description: The year we got serious — or at least pretended to. Internships, projects, and the realization that the real world was coming for us.

memories.caption: Internship season — everyone suddenly wearing formal clothes and looking confused.
Mini project presentation. We rehearsed 40 times. Still fumbled. Still passed.
The seminar where we sounded way smarter than we actually were.
Industrial visit vlog — more food, less industry. Perfect balance.
The trip we took between submissions. We deserved it.
Open source contributions, side projects, and dreams we hadn't killed yet.

years.label: Final Year
years.description: The year we didn't want to end. Every moment felt heavier, more precious. We laughed louder knowing the last day was coming.

memories.caption: Final year project kickoff. Eight months of pain, wrapped in a beautiful slideshow.
Placement season. Ties, blazers, and absolutely nothing making sense.
Last lecture ever. We sat there trying not to cry. Some of us failed.
The farewell video we made for our seniors — and then made one for ourselves.
Convocation day. Four years. One moment. A thousand feelings.
Last day together. We promised to stay close. We meant it.
